may19 training trajectories

Per-epoch train_loss + val QWK curves for every combiner sweep, plus the per-epoch CSV log for the LoRA-FT supervised probe. Kinematic baseline (LightGBM) has no per-epoch concept and the tstats grid only logs config-level summaries, so they don't appear here.

What to look for. The combiner runs overfit aggressively: train_loss → 0.0 within 30–60 epochs while val QWK plateaus around 0.4–0.5. Larger models overfit fastest. The LoRA-FT probe's val Spearman climbs monotonically (0.46 → 0.53) but val QWK is noisy because the softmax argmax bounces between collapsed and recovering — a sign that the encoder learns a usable ordering but the categorical head can't decide thresholds.

Notes on omissions

  • Kinematic LightGBM: gradient boosting has per-iteration tree-add training, but no per-epoch loss in the sense used here. The results_stride2.json records only the best-iteration metric.
  • Tstats velocity grid: train_temporal_encoder.py logs only new_best lines (config-level summaries) to stdout; it does not write per-epoch loss curves. To get those, the script would need a per-config CSV writer added to fit_one.
  • V-JEPA cache jobs: pure inference, no training.
